title: Vision-as-a-Tool: Visual Harness for Multimodal Agentic Coding
abstract: arXiv:2611.17797v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal agentic coding requires robust visual reasoning to analyze observations and evaluate generated artifacts. Current frameworks largely rely on a Thinking-with-Images paradigm, where agents depend on their intrinsic vision to execute visually grounded tasks. However, this architectural coupling introduces a fundamental bottleneck. Agent performance remains strictly bounded by internal perceptual limitations. Furthermore, text-only agents lack native perception. Without specialized tools, they cannot perform visual reasoning. To overcome these constraints, we introduce the Vision-as-a-Tool (VaaT) paradigm. Prior visual tool-use merely manipulates images for an agent's intrinsic vision to read. In contrast, VaaT reframes general-purpose multimodal large language models (MLLMs) as callable external utilities. translated_title: 视觉即工具：面向多模态智能体编程的视觉框架
translated_abstract: 多模态智能体编程需要强大的视觉推理能力，以便分析观察结果并评估生成的产物。当前的框架主要依赖于“以图像思考”范式，即智能体依赖其内在视觉来执行视觉相关的任务。然而，这种架构上的耦合引入了一个根本性瓶颈：智能体的性能严格受限于其内部感知能力的局限。此外，纯文本智能体缺乏原生感知能力，没有专门的工具就无法进行视觉推理。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了“视觉即工具”范式。以往的视觉工具使用仅仅是为智能体的内在视觉操作图像以便其读取，相比之下，VaaT 将通用多模态大语言模型重新定义为可调用的外部工具。由此，纯文本智能体可以在智能体执行过程中完全卸载视觉推理任务，而具备视觉能力的智能体……
tldr: 该论文提出“视觉即工具”范式，将通用多模态大语言模型重新定义为可调用的外部工具，使纯文本智能体能够完全卸载视觉推理，从而突破智能体自身感知能力对性能的限制。
